CREATE TABLE month_close_acks (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      month TEXT NOT NULL,
      item_key TEXT NOT NULL,
      state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('done','na')),
      note TEXT,
      acked_by TEXT REFERENCES users(id),
      acked_at TEXT DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
      updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
      deleted_at TEXT
    )
